context: Naoko organizes a baby shower gift; arranges items together.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: さくらちゃん、出産お祝い、ようけ並べたで!
lines.en: Sakura — I've laid out a whole bunch of birth gifts for you!
lines.style: Bright, energetic Kansai accent. Fast-paced and generous. Warmth that fills the room without needing a response. Slightly performative — she wants to be seen doing this.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: まあ、愛情、こもってますね。
lines.en: Wow — there's so much love packed into all of this.
lines.style: Warm and genuine. Softer attack than her usual tone. Sincere without being flowery. She means it, and lets it land.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Everyone wanted to share their heart with you.
lines.style: Quieter than before, more tender. Kansai still there but the volume drops. She's not performing now — she's saying something that matters.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 隠し贈り物も、ありますか?
lines.en: Wait — did you hide some gifts too?
lines.style: Playful, teasing lilt. Light and curious. A smile in the voice. She's testing her aunt, enjoying the moment.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.jp: ふふ、内緒の物、配ってあるで!
lines.en: Heh — of course I've already hidden some things around here!
lines.style: Conspiratorial and pleased with herself. Kansai brightness back. A laugh underneath it. She loves having secrets that are actually nice surprises.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: おばさん、感心しますね。
lines.en: You really think of everything, don't you.
lines.style: Warm admiration, almost wondering. Not a question — a recognition. She's looking at her aunt differently in this moment.

lines.speaker: naoko_aunt
lines.en: Of course I do — you're family!
lines.style: Loud, unshakeable conviction. Kansai assertiveness. No room for argument. Pride and love said the same way.
